log.before: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

log.before: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
log.after: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

log.before: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

log.before: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.
log.after: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

log.before: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
log.after: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

log.before: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

log.before: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.
log.after: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

log.before: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
log.after: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

log.after: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

log.before: Wait for the Lord; be strong and take heart and wait for the Lord.
log.after: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

log.before: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
log.after: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

log.before: I love you, Lord, my strength.
log.after: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

log.before: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

log.before: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

log.before: Strengthen the feeble hands, steady the knees that give way.

log.before: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
log.after: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

log.after: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

log.after: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

log.after: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

log.before: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
log.after: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

log.after: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

log.after: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

log.after: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

log.after: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

log.before: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.
log.after: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

log.before: And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.
log.after: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

log.before: Let all that you do be done in love.
log.after: Let all that you do be done in love.

log.before: Hatred stirs up conflict, but love covers over all wrongs.
log.after: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

log.before: Many waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away.
log.after: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

log.after: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yahweh.

log.before: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.
log.after: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.

log.after: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

log.after: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

log.after: Depart from evil, and do good. seek peace, and pursue it.

log.after: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

log.before: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
log.after: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

log.before: Great peace have those who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.
log.after: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

log.before: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.
log.after: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.

log.after: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

log.after: The work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

log.after: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

log.after: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

log.after: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

log.before: Jesus said to him, 'If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.'
log.after: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

log.before: And suddenly, a woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years came from behind and touched the hem of His garment.
log.after: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

log.before: But Jesus turned around, and when He saw her He said, 'Be of good cheer, daughter; your faith has made you well.' And the woman was made well from that hour.
log.after: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

log.before: And wherever He entered, into villages, cities, or the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged Him that they might just touch the hem of His garment. And as many as touched Him were made well.
log.after: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

log.before: My son, pay attention to what I say; turn your ear to my words. Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart; for they are life to those who find them and health to one's whole body.
log.after: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings. Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart. For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

log.before: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.
log.after: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

log.before: They will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.
log.after: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

log.before: Return, faithless people; I will cure you of backsliding.
log.after: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.

log.before: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.
log.after: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

log.before: And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes; there shall be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying. There shall be no more pain, for the former things have passed away.
log.after: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”

log.before: Is anyone among you suffering? Let him pray. Is anyone cheerful? Let him sing psalms.
log.after: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

log.before: And he said to the woman, 'Your faith has saved you; go in peace.'
log.after: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

log.before: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.
log.after: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

log.before: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.
log.after: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

log.before: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, 'Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother or sister who sins against me? Up to seven times?' Jesus answered, 'Not seven times, but seventy-seven times.'
log.after: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?” Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

log.before: For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
log.after: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

log.before: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
log.after: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

log.before: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace.
log.after: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

log.before: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.
log.after: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

log.before: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.
log.after: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

log.before: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
log.after: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

log.before: But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.
log.after: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

log.before: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
log.after: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

log.before: Blessed is the one whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
log.after: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

log.before: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions, for my own sake, and remembers your sins no more.
log.after: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.

log.before: The Lord is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.
log.after: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

log.before: He does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.
log.after: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

log.before: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits—who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases.
log.after: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits; who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;

log.before: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins.
log.after: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

log.before: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.
log.after: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

log.before: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
log.after: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

log.before: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
log.after: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

log.before: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice.
log.after: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.

log.before: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
log.after: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

log.before: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our troubles.
log.after: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort; who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

log.before: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
log.after: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

log.before: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you; and you will be comforted over Jerusalem.
log.after: As one whom his mother comforts, so will I comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

log.before: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
log.after: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

log.before: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
log.after: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

log.before: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
log.after: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

log.before: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.
log.after: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

log.before: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
log.after: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

log.before: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.
log.after: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

log.before: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
log.after: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

log.before: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.
log.after: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

log.before: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your promise gives me life.
log.after: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

log.before: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy.
log.after: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

log.before: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
log.after: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

log.before: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy.
log.after: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

log.before: I will turn their mourning into gladness; I will give them comfort and joy instead of sorrow.
log.after: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance; the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

log.before: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.
log.after: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

log.before: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.
log.after: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

log.before: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners.
log.after: The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me; because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and release to those who are bound;

log.before: To comfort all who mourn, and provide for those who grieve in Zion—to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair.
log.after: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn; to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahweh, that he may be glorified.

log.before: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
log.after: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

log.before: Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
log.after: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

log.before: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul.
log.after: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

log.before: Let Your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for Your law is my delight.
log.after: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

log.before: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.
log.after: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

log.before: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
log.after: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

log.before: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
log.after: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

log.before: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
log.after: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

log.before: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn away from them.
log.after: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

log.before: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom, and whatever you get, get insight.
log.after: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

log.before: But the wisdom from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, open to reason, full of mercy and good fruits, impartial and sincere.
log.after: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

log.before: Wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
log.after: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

log.before: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
log.after: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

log.before: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
log.after: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

log.before: The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice.
log.after: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

log.before: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.
log.after: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

log.before: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.
log.after: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

log.before: The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.
log.after: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

log.before: A wise man will hear and increase learning, and a man of understanding will attain wise counsel.
log.after: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:

log.before: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to get insight rather than silver!
log.after: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

log.before: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.
log.after: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

log.before: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.
log.after: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

log.before: Instruct the wise and they will be wiser still; teach the righteous and they will add to their learning.
log.after: Instruct a wise man, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.

log.before: A fool gives full vent to his anger, but a wise man keeps himself under control.
log.after: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

log.before: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.
log.after: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

log.before: To humans belong the plans of the heart, but from the Lord comes the proper answer of the tongue.
log.after: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

log.before: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails.
log.after: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

log.before: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
log.after: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

log.before: The fear of the Lord teaches wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
log.after: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

log.before: Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer harm.
log.after: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

log.before: Wisdom cries aloud in the street, in the markets she raises her voice.
log.after: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

log.before: The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens.
log.after: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

log.before: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding.
log.after: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

log.before: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.
log.after: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

log.before: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
log.after: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

log.before: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.
log.after: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

log.before: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold her fast will be blessed.
log.after: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

log.before: By me kings reign and rulers issue decrees that are just.
log.after: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

log.before: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.
log.after: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

log.before: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.
log.after: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

log.before: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.
log.after: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold; my yield than choice silver.

log.before: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice.
log.after: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice;

log.before: The Lord brought me forth as the first of his works, before his deeds of old.
log.after: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

log.before: Then I was constantly at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence.
log.after: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

log.before: Now then, my children, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.
log.after: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

log.before: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not disregard it.
log.after: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

log.before: Blessed are those who listen to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.
log.after: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

log.before: For those who find me find life and receive favor from the Lord.
log.after: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

log.before: But whoever fails to find me harms themselves; all who hate me love death.
log.after: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

log.before: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.
log.after: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

log.before: Your commands are always with me and make me wiser than my enemies.
log.after: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

log.before: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.
log.after: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

log.before: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.
log.after: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

log.before: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, 'This is the way; walk in it.'
log.after: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

log.before: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.
log.after: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

log.before: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
log.after: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

log.before: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
log.after: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

log.before: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and He delights in his way.
log.after: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

log.before: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails.
log.after: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

log.before: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.
log.after: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

log.before: Show me your ways, Lord, teach me your paths.
log.after: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

log.before: Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.
log.after: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.

log.before: Good and upright is the Lord; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.
log.after: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

log.before: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.
log.after: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

log.before: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.
log.after: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

log.before: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.
log.after: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

log.before: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.
log.after: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

log.before: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.
log.after: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

log.before: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
log.after: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

log.before: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.
log.after: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

log.before: Make plans by seeking advice; if you wage war, obtain guidance.
log.after: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

log.before: Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.
log.after: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, To your tents.

log.before: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth.
log.after: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

log.before: For those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God.
log.after: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

log.before: The Lord will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame.
log.after: and Yahweh will guide you continually, and satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong; and you shall be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters don’t fail.

log.before: I am the Lord your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.
log.after: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

log.before: The Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
log.after: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

log.before: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
log.after: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.

log.before: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you hope and a future.
log.after: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

log.before: Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
log.after: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

log.before: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness.
log.after: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

log.before: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
log.after: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

log.before: Ponder the path of your feet; then all your ways will be sure.
log.after: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

log.before: The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice.
log.after: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

log.before: Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer harm.
log.after: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

log.before: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.
log.after: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

log.before: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will.
log.after: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

log.before: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
log.after: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

log.before: Lead me in the right path, O Lord, or my enemies will conquer me. Make your way plain for me to follow.
log.after: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

log.before: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.
log.after: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

log.before: Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
log.after: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

log.before: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
log.after: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

log.before: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
log.after: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

log.before: And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
log.after: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

log.before: Seek the Lord while he may be found; call on him while he is near.
log.after: Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

log.before: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
log.after: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

log.before: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
log.after: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

log.before: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
log.after: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

log.before: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
log.after: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

log.before: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.
log.after: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

log.before: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.
log.after: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

log.before: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. His love endures forever.
log.after: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

log.before: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful.
log.after: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

log.before: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
log.after: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

log.before: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!
log.after: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

log.before: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.
log.after: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

log.before: I thank my God every time I remember you.
log.after: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

log.before: We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers.
log.after: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

log.before: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.
log.after: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

log.before: Praise the Lord. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.
log.after: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

log.before: I will praise God's name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.
log.after: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

log.before: Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
log.after: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

log.before: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.
log.after: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

log.before: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
log.after: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.

log.before: Since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
log.after: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

log.before: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth. Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
log.after: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands! Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

log.before: Know that the Lord is God. It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
log.after: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

log.before: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.
log.after: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

log.before: This is the day the Lord has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
log.after: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

log.before: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.
log.after: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

log.before: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High.
log.after: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High;

log.before: To proclaim your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night.
log.after: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

log.before: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among the throngs I will praise you.
log.after: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

log.before: Sing to the Lord with grateful praise; make music to our God on the harp.
log.after: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

log.before: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit, singing to God with gratitude in your hearts.
log.after: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

log.before: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
log.after: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

log.before: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us.
log.after: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

log.before: Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; and to him who orders his conduct aright I will show the salvation of God.
log.after: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

log.before: I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.
log.after: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

log.before: Oh, that men would give thanks to the Lord for His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the children of men!
log.after: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

log.before: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.
log.after: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

log.before: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.
log.after: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

log.before: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart; before the 'gods' I will sing your praise.
log.after: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

log.before: I will bow down toward your holy temple and will praise your name for your unfailing love and your faithfulness.
log.after: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

log.before: All the kings of the earth will praise you, Lord, when they hear what you have decreed.
log.after: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

log.before: They will sing of the ways of the Lord, for the glory of the Lord is great.
log.after: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh; for great is Yahweh’s glory.

log.before: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.
log.after: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

log.before: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.
log.after: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

log.before: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the Lord is to be praised.
log.after: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.

log.before: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.
log.after: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

log.before: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.
log.after: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

log.before: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.
log.after: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.

log.before: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you.
log.after: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

log.before: No weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you.
log.after: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.

log.before: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
log.after: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

log.before: I will say of the Lord, 'He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.'
log.after: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

log.before: Surely he will save you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.
log.after: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

log.before: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day.
log.after: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;

log.before: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
log.after: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

log.before: If you say, 'The Lord is my refuge,' and you make the Most High your dwelling.
log.after: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

log.before: No harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.
log.after: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

log.before: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
log.after: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

log.before: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
log.after: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

log.before: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
log.after: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

log.before: The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life—of whom shall I be afraid?
log.after: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

log.before: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.
log.after: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

log.before: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent and set me high upon a rock.
log.after: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

log.before: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
log.after: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

log.before: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea.
log.after: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

log.before: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
log.after: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

log.before: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.
log.after: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

log.before: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
log.after: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

log.before: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
log.after: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

log.before: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.
log.after: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

log.before: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
log.after: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

log.before: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.
log.after: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress— I will never be greatly shaken.

log.before: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.
log.after: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

log.before: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.
log.after: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

log.before: My salvation and my honor depend on God; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.
log.after: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

log.before: Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.
log.after: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

log.before: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
log.after: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

log.before: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.
log.after: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

log.before: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord's unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.
log.after: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

log.before: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.
log.after: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.

log.before: The Lord watches over you—the Lord is your shade at your right hand.
log.after: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

log.before: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
log.after: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

log.before: The Lord will keep you from all harm—he will watch over your life.
log.after: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

log.before: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.
log.after: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

log.before: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms.
log.after: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

log.before: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.
log.after: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

log.before: You, Lord, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.
log.after: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

log.before: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.
log.after: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

log.before: As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord's word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.
log.after: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

log.before: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
log.after: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

log.before: You make your saving help my shield, and your right hand sustains me; your help has made me great.
log.after: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

log.before: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.
log.after: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

log.before: The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you; the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.
log.after: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you. Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

log.before: Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is in him.
log.after: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.

log.before: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
log.after: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

log.before: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ.
log.after: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;

log.before: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
log.after: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

log.before: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
log.after: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

log.before: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
log.after: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

log.before: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
log.after: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.

log.before: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
log.after: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

log.before: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
log.after: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

log.before: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
log.after: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

log.before: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
log.after: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

log.before: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me.
log.after: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

log.before: They will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream.
log.after: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green; and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.

log.before: Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked or stand in the way that sinners take or sit in the company of mockers.
log.after: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

log.before: But whose delight is in the law of the Lord, and who meditates on his law day and night.
log.after: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

log.before: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither—whatever they do prospers.
log.after: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

log.before: Blessed are those whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
log.after: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

log.before: Blessed is the one whose sin the Lord does not count against them and in whose spirit is no deceit.
log.after: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

log.before: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people he chose for his inheritance.
log.after: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

log.before: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.
log.after: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

log.before: Blessed are those who have regard for the weak; the Lord delivers them in times of trouble.
log.after: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

log.before: The Lord protects and preserves them—they are counted among the blessed in the land—he does not give them over to the desire of their foes.
log.after: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

log.before: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you.
log.after: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

log.before: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
log.after: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

log.before: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.
log.after: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

log.before: Lord Almighty, blessed is the one who trusts in you.
log.after: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

log.before: Blessed are all who fear the Lord, who walk in obedience to him.
log.after: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

log.before: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.
log.after: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

log.before: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
log.after: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants, around your table.

log.before: Yes, this will be the blessing for the man who fears the Lord.
log.after: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.

log.before: May the Lord bless you from Zion; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
log.after: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

log.before: But he said, 'Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.'
log.after: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

log.before: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!
log.after: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

log.before: From the fullness of his grace we have all received one blessing after another.
log.after: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

log.before: Jesus said to him, 'Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.'
log.after: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.”

log.before: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace.
log.after: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

log.before: that he lavished on us. With all wisdom and understanding.
log.after: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

log.before: And you also were included in Christ when you heard the message of truth, the gospel of your salvation.
log.after: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
